Subtle Tint (10%)

Tag
Tag
Solid
--opacity-10 · Subtle background tints
Transparency ramps

Pre-mixed white and black at seven steps, as 8-digit hex. Reach for these when a tint has to sit over unknown artwork — the on-dark surfaces use them. For a tint of a SEMANTIC colour use color-mix() over the token instead, so it follows into dark mode. Every swatch sits on a checkerboard, so a 1% white and a 1% black are both legible against it.
